### 2026-10-07 – I created the github repo, I thought long and hard what the repo should be called then decided to go for the name, "half-life-starbieee"... Ik, very clever and original...

**1h**

I created the github repo, I thought long and hard what the repo should be called then decided to go for the name, "half-life-starbieee"... Ik, very clever and original...
